payout_quote: SUMMARY OF PAY — Judges (5): May 30, 31 & June 1 $95/day; June 2 (Election Day) $120; In-Person Training $45; Online Training $20; bonus for serving all 4 days $20; Total Possible $510 (English Only), $535 (Bilingual). PAY FOR SERVICE WILL BE MAILED 4-6 WEEKS AFTER ELECTION DAY. (June 2, 2026 Statewide Primary Election, Alameda County Registrar of Voters).
steps: Be at least 16 years old on or before Election Day, a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, with a minimum GPA of 2.5.
Complete and return the High School Student Election Worker Application (email, fax, or mail) to the Alameda County Registrar of Voters.
Receive a Notice of Appointment by email with assigned Vote Center and training class.
Complete mandatory training (in-person $45 + online $20, separately paid; training durations unstated, excluded from payout and time below).
Serve at the Vote Center: May 30 (7:30 AM - 6:00 PM), May 31 (8:00 AM - 6:00 PM), June 1 (8:00 AM - 6:00 PM), Election Day June 2 (6:00 AM - 9:00 PM).
catches: This pay table is the county's High School Student Election Worker program (age 16+, GPA 2.5, parent/school approval).
Election-period work only - 4 vote-center days around the June 2, 2026 election.
Mandatory training pays $45 (in-person) + $20 (online) separately; its duration is unstated so it is excluded from the payout and time below.
No pay for training you cancel.
Pay mailed 4-6 weeks after Election Day.
biggest_catch: This is the county's high-school student election worker schedule (16+, GPA 2.5 required) - $445-$470 for 4 posted vote-center days; mandatory training ($65) is separate with unstated duration.
eligibility: Age 16+ by Election Day; U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident; GPA 2.5+; parent/guardian and school approval; mandatory training.
timing: Pay mailed 4-6 weeks after Election Day.
